description: Production incident: A payment processing service is experiencing critical failures. Analyze the exported production log file at /home/ga/workspace/logs/payment_service.log (800+ lines) to identify the root cause error. The log contains many INFO and DEBUG messages - you need to find the critical ERROR with a stack trace. Once found, extract the exact file path and line number from the stack trace (e.g., 'File "/home/ga/workspace/src/payment_processor.py", line 127'). Navigate to that specific line in VSCode and add a TODO comment (starting with # TODO:) at or near that line documenting the error for the next engineer. The TODO should mention what error occurred (e.g., AttributeError, NoneType, api_key issue). Save the file when done.
